chats.answer:
Yes, you can use a projector without Wi-Fi. Many projectors work completely offline, and some can even play movies without connecting to a phone or laptop.

There are three main options:

HDMI projector: Connect a laptop, gaming console, or media player with an HDMI cable. No Wi-Fi needed.

USB projector: Play videos directly from a USB flash drive, provided the projector supports video playback.

Offline portable projector: Some models have built-in media players or support screen mirroring without a Wi-Fi router.

Important: A projector advertised as having Wi-Fi doesn't necessarily require Wi-Fi to function.

chats.answer:
You can absolutely use a projector without Wi-Fi. Many projectors work completely offline, as long as they support HDMI, USB, or another wired connection.

Here are your main options:

HDMI projector: Connect a laptop, gaming console, or media player directly. No Wi-Fi required.

USB projector: Play videos or photos from a USB flash drive, provided the projector supports media playback.

Offline portable projector: Some models have built-in media players and can play downloaded content.

Phone-compatible projector: Connect your phone using a compatible USB-C-to-HDMI or Lightning-to-HDMI adapter.

Important: A projector advertised as having Wi-Fi doesn't necessarily require Wi-Fi. Most smart projectors can also display video through HDMI without an internet connection.
